scope: Independent boundary fixtures: data/AST/state budgets, exact step idempotence, actual Node Worker scheduling, isolated DOM lifecycle and protected raw storage. Not a native browser/GPU assertion.

checks.name: JSON AST rejects prototype/extra/accessor/sparse fields before they can become executable data
Imported state has exact keys, four dense slots, per-node bounds and a bounded non-recursive fault payload
Repeated same-step calls do not integrate twice; subrate and snapshot continuation remain deterministic
Static 80-node and per-decision operation budgets are bounded; arithmetic overflow never commits partial integration
Cancel and observer failure release the actual height command without teleporting; snapshot redecision includes initial controller state
Actual Worker scheduling rejects concurrent/duplicate jobs and cooperatively returns a cancelled partial physical result
UI ignores stale Worker callbacks, closes malformed/cancel-post failures and keeps protected bytes untouched
